data.title: Lunit and Summit Therapeutics Announce Agreement to Apply AI-powered SCOPE IO Platform for Tumor Microenvironment Analysis in Immuno-Oncology Development
data.description:
Lunit and Summit Therapeutics Announce Agreement to Apply AI-powered SCOPE IO Platform for Tumor Microenvironment Analysis in Immuno-Oncology Development

Lunit and Summit Therapeutics Announce Agreement to Apply AI-powered SCOPE IO Platform for Tumor Microenvironment Analysis in Immuno-Oncology Development

PR Newswire

SEOUL, South Korea, Oct. 24, 2026

Research Will Use Lunit's AI-powered Pathology Platform to Analyze H&E Whole-Slide Images and Generate Scalable Insights into Tumor Microenvironment Biology

SEOUL, South Korea, Oct. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lunit Inc. (KRX: 328130) and Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced a research agreement to evaluate the use of Lunit SCOPE IO, Lunit's AI-powered pathology platform, for tumor microenvironment analysis in support of Summit's immuno-oncology development programs with ivonescimab.

The effort will focus on applying Lunit SCOPE IO to hematoxylin and eosin-stained (H&E) whole-slide images to characterize tumor microenvironment features. The companies aim to explore how AI-powered pathology analysis can support biomarker discovery, patient stratification or selection, and a deeper biological understanding of response to ivonescimab therapies.

Summit is developing ivonescimab, a novel, potential first-in-class investigational PD-1 / VEGF bispecific antibody, in several solid tumors. Lunit SCOPE IO is designed to support immuno-oncology research and biomarker development through AI-powered analysis of H&E slides, enabling scalable assessment of tumor microenvironment features without requiring additional stains or assays.

"Understanding the tumor microenvironment is increasingly important as immuno-oncology moves beyond single-axis checkpoint inhibition toward more complex mechanisms and combinations," said Allen Yang, MD, PhD, Chief Research and Development Strategy Officer of Summit. "We are pleased to work with Lunit to explore how AI-powered pathology can help generate deeper, more scalable insights from routine tissue samples and inform the continued development of ivonescimab."

"Summit is at the forefront of next-generation immuno-oncology development, and we are excited to support its efforts with Lunit SCOPE IO," said Brandon Suh, Lunit CEO. "By extracting quantitative, spatially resolved immune and tumor microenvironment features from standard H&E slides, we believe SCOPE IO can help biopharma partners better understand which patients may benefit from immuno-oncology therapies and why."

This agreement reflects the growing importance of computational pathology in oncology drug development. Routine H&E slides contain rich information about tumor architecture, immune infiltration, stromal organization, and spatial interactions within the tumor microenvironment. However, traditional manual assessment can be difficult to scale and may not fully capture the quantitative and spatial complexity of the tumor-immune interface. AI-powered analysis offers the potential to convert these routinely generated pathology images into reproducible, high-dimensional biomarker data.

The companies expect the work to generate tumor microenvironment insights that may inform future translational research, exploratory biomarker strategies, and clinical development planning. No clinical outcome data are being announced as part of this release.

 *Lunit SCOPE products are for research use only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures or decisions.

About Ivonescimab

Ivonescimab, known as SMT112 in Summit's license territories, North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Japan, and as AK112 outside of Summit's license territories, is a novel, potential first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody combining the effects of immunotherapy via a blockade of PD-1 with the anti-angiogenesis effects associated with blocking VEGF into a single molecule. By design, ivonescimab displays unique cooperative binding to each of its intended targets with multifold higher affinity to PD-1 when in the presence of VEGF.

This design is intended to differentiate ivonescimab as there is potentially higher expression (presence) of both PD-1 and VEGF in tumor tissue and the tumor microenvironment (TME) as compared to normal tissue in the body. Summit believes ivonescimab's specifically engineered tetravalent structure (four binding sites) enables higher avidity (accumulated strength of multiple binding interactions) in the TME (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025). This tetravalent structure, the intentional novel design of the molecule, and bringing these two targets into a single bispecific antibody with cooperative binding qualities have the potential to direct ivonescimab to the tumor tissue versus healthy tissue. The intent of ivonescimab's design, together with a half-life of 6 to 7 days after the first dose (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025) increasing to approximately 10 days at steady state dosing, is to improve upon previously established efficacy thresholds, side effects, and safety profiles associated with prior approved drugs to these targets.

Ivonescimab was invented by Akeso Inc. (HKEX Code: 9926.HK) and is currently utilized in multiple Phase III clinical trials. Over 5,000 patients have been treated with ivonescimab in clinical studies globally and over 100,000 patients when considering those treated in a commercial setting in China, as noted by Akeso.

There are currently 17 Phase III clinical studies that are either announced, ongoing, or have been completed studying ivonescimab, five of which are Summit-sponsored global studies, two of which are studies sponsored by cooperative groups, and 10 of which are being or have been conducted in China by Akeso. Summit began its clinical development of ivonescimab in NSCLC (HARMONi, HARMONi-3, HARMONi-7) and expanded its sponsored Phase III clinical development program into colorectal cancer (CRC; HARMONi-GI3) and urothelial carcinoma (bladder cancer; HARMONi-GU1). The two cooperative studies are in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC; ILLUMINE) and biliary tract cancer (BTC; EA2251).

Five Phase III ivonescimab clinical trials have read out to date, all five with positive data. Four of these five studies are in NSCLC and one is in BTC. In addition to Summit's positive HARMONi study in NSCLC, Akeso has had positive read-outs in four single-region (China), randomized Phase III clinical trials, HARMONi-A, HARMONi-2, HARMONi-6 (each in NSCLC), and HARMONi-GI1 (in BTC) for ivonescimab, including a statistically significant overall survival benefit in all four studies from China.

Akeso is actively conducting additional Phase III clinical studies in settings outside of NSCLC and biliary-tract cancer, including triple-negative breast cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, and pancreatic cancer.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy that is not approved by any regulatory authority in Summit's license territories, including the United States and Europe. Ivonescimab was initially approved for marketing authorization in China in May 2024.

About Lunit

Founded in 2013, Lunit (KRX: 328130) is a global leader on a mission to conquer cancer through AI. Our clinically validated solutions span medical imaging, breast health, and biomarker analysis, empowering earlier detection, smarter treatment decisions, and more precise outcomes across the cancer care continuum.

Lunit offers a comprehensive suite spanning risk prediction and early detection to precision oncology. Our FDA-cleared Lunit INSIGHT Breast Suite and breast health solutions support cancer screening in thousands of medical institutions worldwide, while the Lunit SCOPE platform is used in research partnership with global pharma and laboratory leaders for biomarker research, and companion diagnostic development.

Trusted by over 10,000 sites in more than 65 countries, Lunit combines deep medical expertise with continuously evolving datasets to deliver measurable impact for patients, clinicians, and researchers alike. Headquartered in Seoul with global offices, Lunit is driving the worldwide fight against cancer. Learn more at lunit.io.

About Summit Therapeutics Inc.

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of patient-, physician-, caregiver- and societal-friendly medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and resolve serious unmet medical needs.

Summit was founded in 2003 and the company's shares are listed on the Nasdaq Global Market (symbol "SMMT"). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, with additional offices in Palo Alto, California, Princeton, New Jersey, Dublin, Ireland, and Oxford, UK.

For more information, please visit https://www.smmttx.com and follow Summit on X @SMMT_TX.

DENARIUS METALS FILES TORAL PROJECT TECHNICAL REPORT ON SEDAR+

PR Newswire

TORONTO, Oct. 23, 2026

TORONTO, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Denarius Metals Corp. (Cboe CA: DMET) (OTCQX: DNRSF) ("Denarius Metals" or "the Company") announced today the filing of a National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects compliant technical report in support of the Mineral Resource estimate for its 100%-owned Toral Project. The technical report, entitled "Technical Report on the Toral Zn-Pb-Ag Project, Leon Province, Castilla y Leon, Spain" with an effective date of July 24, 2026, was prepared by Resource Development Associates and supports the disclosures made by the Company in its news release dated September 9, 2026. The technical report can be found on the Company's website at www.denariusmetals.com and by reviewing its profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

  10. Contained metal is in situ. No metallurgical recovery is applied to contained-metal figures. Metal values, if quoted, are illustrative only and are not NSR or revenue.
  11. Bulk density (mineralized): 2.73 + 0.022 × (Pb% + Zn%). Waste assigned 2.70 g/cm³.
  12. Numbers are rounded. Totals may not add due to rounding. All tonnes are metric.
  13. The mineralized structure remains open along strike to the southeast and at depth.

About Denarius Metals

Denarius Metals is a Canadian junior company engaged in the acquisition, exploration, development and eventual operation of precious metals and polymetallic mining projects in high-grade districts in Colombia and Spain. Denarius Metals is listed on Cboe Canada where it trades under the symbol "DMET". The Company also trades on the OTCQX Market in the United States under the symbol "DNRSF".

In Colombia, Denarius Metals is producing gold and silver in an "early production" phase at its 100%-owned Zancudo Project while it completes construction a 1,000 tonnes per day processing plant that is expected to start producing high-grade gold-silver concentrates by the first quarter of 2027. The Zancudo Project is a high-grade gold-silver deposit, which includes the historic producing Independencia mine, and is located in the Cauca Belt, about 30 km southwest of Medellin.

In Spain, Denarius Metals has interests in three projects focused on in-demand critical minerals. The Company owns a 21.8% interest in Rio Narcea Recursos, S.L. and is the operator of its Aguablanca Project, which has been recognized by the EU as a Strategic Project. The Aguablanca Project comprises a turnkey 5,000 tonnes per day processing plant and the rights to exploit the historic producing Aguablanca nickel-copper mine, located in Monesterio, Extremadura. Denarius Metals also owns a 100% interest in the Lomero Project, a polymetallic deposit located on the Spanish side of the prolific copper rich Iberian Pyrite Belt, approximately 88 km southwest of the Aguablanca Project, and a 100% interest in the Toral Project, a high-grade zinc-lead-silver deposit located in the Leon Province, Northern Spain.

Additional information on Denarius Metals can be found on its website at www.denariusmetals.com and by reviewing its profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

data.title: Genesis Healthcare Announces Effective Date of Chapter 11 Plan Following Consummation of Sale to West State Street
data.description:
Genesis Healthcare Announces Effective Date of Chapter 11 Plan Following Consummation of Sale to West State Street

Genesis Healthcare, Inc. (“Genesis”) today announced that its chapter 11 plan became effective, following the closing of the sale of substantially all of its operating assets to 101 W. State Street, LLC (“West State Street”) on October 14, 2026.

On behalf of the Board of Directors, the Company thanks its management team, its employees and staff for their focus and dedication throughout the chapter 11 process. Despite a long and complex case, the Company’s financial and quality of care metrics continued to improve substantially.

“The employees and staff were the heart of this Genesis organization. Throughout this complex bankruptcy case, they stayed focused on the people in their care, kept operations strong, and continued the operational turnaround that remained Genesis’ focus prior to, and during, the bankruptcy process,” said David Harrington, outgoing Chairman of the Board. “On behalf of the Board, I thank them for their commitment and hard work. We wish West State Street every success as it carries these operations into the future.”

Advisors

McDermott Will & Schulte served as legal counsel, Ankura Consulting provided financial restructuring and Chief Restructuring Officer services (Russell A. Perry and Louis E. Robichaux IV, Co-CROs), and Jefferies served as exclusive investment banker.

ABOUT GENESIS HEALTHCARE, INC.

Genesis HealthCare, Inc. is a holding company with affiliates that previously operated skilled nursing facilities and assisted/senior living communities. Its subsidiaries also specialized in contract rehabilitation therapy, respiratory therapy, physician services, and accountable care.

data.title: LEAP Group Relaunches HumanView, a Growth Intelligence System Built to Explain Why Customers Behave the Way They Do
data.description:
LEAP Group Relaunches HumanView, a Growth Intelligence System Built to Explain Why Customers Behave the Way They Do

LEAP Group Relaunches HumanView, a Growth Intelligence System Built to Explain Why Customers Behave the Way They Do

PR Newswire

LOUISVILLE, Ky., Oct. 23, 2026

Reimagined from the ground up, HumanView pairs statistical modeling with expert analysts to turn millions of real-world customer signals into business decisions

LOUISVILLE, Ky., Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LEAP Group today announced the relaunch of HumanView, its growth intelligence service. The new version has been rebuilt from the ground up and now has a dedicated home at leapgroupnetwork.com/humanview.

HumanView analyzes what customers say and do across social platforms, e-commerce sites, review platforms, search behavior and user-generated content, including signals from Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, Meta, Amazon and Walmart+ that general AI tools cannot always access. Because the data reflects unprompted, real-world behavior, it avoids the response bias built into surveys and focus groups.

The service works in three layers. HumanView captures signals at scale, decodes millions of records through validated statistical models such as regression, correlation and clustering, and then relies on experienced analysts to interpret the patterns. Clients receive clear, human-validated insights instead of another dashboard.

"Machines find the patterns. Humans find the point," said Alan Gilleo, CEO at LEAP Group. "The first version of HumanView showed us how much customers reveal when nobody is asking them questions. This version is built to explain why they act the way they do, and to put those answers in front of everyone making decisions, from product to service to marketing."

HumanView focuses on three areas:

  • Growth Intelligence: customer motivations and how people perceive a brand and its competitors

  • Market and Category Intelligence: product pain points, service friction, unmet needs and competitive gaps

  • Audience Intelligence: new segments, positioning opportunities and gaps in the market

Every model is designed and validated by data scientists and benchmarked before it informs a recommendation.

To learn more about HumanView, visit leapgroupnetwork.com/humanview.

About LEAP Group
LEAP Group is a boutique marketing agency holding company with offices in Louisville, Indianapolis, Cincinnati and Chicago. Guided by the belief that brands should "Market Less. Matter More.," LEAP gives clients access to specialized experts across its entire network. Learn more at leapgroupnetwork.com.

data.title: US Metro Bancorp Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
data.description:
US Metro Bancorp Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

US Metro Bancorp (OTCQX: USMT): US Metro Bancorp (“Bancorp”) is a bank holding company, with a single subsidiary, US Metro Bank (“Bank”). On a consolidated basis, Bancorp earned $3.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $3.5 million in the second quarter of 2026. For the nine months ending September 30, 2026, the consolidated Bancorp earned $9.9 million compared to $8.0 million for the nine months ending September 30, 2025. On a year-to-date basis, Bancorp recorded an annualized return on average assets (“ROAA”) of 0.80% and an annualized return on average equity (“ROAE”) of 11.32%. With 16,791,500 shares outstanding, earnings per share (“EPS”) for the third quarter of 2026 was $0.19 compared to $0.21 in the second quarter of 2026. For the nine months ending September 30, 2026, EPS was $0.59 compared to $0.48 for the nine months ending September 30, 2025. On September 30, 2026, Bancorp’s book value per share was $7.06 compared to $6.62 a year earlier.

The Bank recorded on a year-to-date basis net interest income of $39.9 million compared to $33.1 million in the same period a year earlier. Net income of $11.7 million for the nine months ending September 30, 2026, compared to $9.2 million reported for the same nine months in 2025, a year over year increase of $2.55 million.

The Bank reported total assets of $1.730 billion as of September 30, 2026, representing a 10.2% increase compared to the reporting period ending September 30, 2025, and year over year loan growth of $157 million or 12.4%. Total Bank deposits ended the third quarter of 2026 at $1.527 billion, a $143 million or 10.3% increase from $1.384 billion on September 30, 2025.

Non-performing assets as a percentage of total assets of 1.39% on September 30, 2026, compared to 1.46% as of September 30, 2025. The Bank had $2.3 million Other Real Estate Owned (OREO) on September 30, 2026. Allowance for credit losses (ACL) to gross loans was 1.25% as of September 30, 2026, compared to 1.19% as of September 30, 2025. The Bank recorded a $7.6 million provision for credit losses, for the nine months ending September 30, 2026, compared to $2.2 million recorded for the nine months ending September 30, 2025.

“Our third quarter results reflect the continued strength of our core franchise. Year-to-date earnings of $9.9 million are up 24% over the same period last year, and we delivered double-digit year-over-year growth in loans, deposits, and total assets. While the third quarter earnings were modestly below the second quarter, we continued to prudently build our allowance for credit losses, and we are encouraged by the improvement in non-performing assets compared to a year ago. With book value per share rising to $7.06, we remain focused on finishing 2026 strong and building long-term value for our shareholders,” said CEO Dong Il Kim.

US Metro Bank is a California chartered, full service commercial bank headquartered in Garden Grove, California. The Bank opened for business on September 15, 2006, and offers deposit and loan products (including commercial real estate, commercial and industrial, mortgage, SBA and USDA loans), as well as related banking services to its customers.

data.title: RxSight Reports Inducement Grants as Permitted by the Nasdaq Listing Rules
data.description:
ALISO VIEJO, Calif., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RxSight, Inc. (NASDAQ: RXST) today announced that on October 23, 2026, RxSight granted inducement stock options to purchase a total of 236,456 shares of RxSight’s common stock to two new non-executive officer employees in connection with the commencement of their employment with RxSight. RxSight also agreed to grant inducement restricted stock units (RSUs) covering a total of 637,449 shares of RxSight’s common stock to the same employees in connection with the commencement of their employment with RxSight, which RSUs are anticipated to be granted on or about November 3, 2026.

Each inducement stock option has an exercise price of $5.02 per share, which is equal to the closing price of a share of RxSight common stock on the grant date, and shall vest as follows, subject to continuing service: 25% of the shares subject to such inducement stock option shall vest on the one year anniversary of October 23, 2026, and one forty-eighth (1/48th) of the shares subject to such inducement stock option shall vest monthly thereafter.

Each inducement RSU award shall vest as follows, subject to continuing service: one-sixth of the shares subject to the inducement RSU award shall vest on the first trading day on or after each of February 28, 2027, August 31, 2027, February 29, 2028, August 31, 2028, February 28, 2029, and August 31, 2029.

Each inducement award is subject to the terms of the RxSight, Inc. 2026 Inducement Equity Incentive Plan and related forms of agreements, and were granted as inducements material to these employees to enter into employment with RxSight in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

About RxSight, Inc.

RxSight, Inc. is an ophthalmic medical device company dedicated to providing high-quality customized vision to patients following cataract surgery. The Light Adjustable Lens™ system, comprised of the RxSight Light Adjustable Lens™ products (LAL™ and LAL+™), RxSight Light Delivery Device™ (LDD™), and accessories, is the first and only commercially available intraocular lens (IOL) technology that can be adjusted after surgery, enabling doctors to customize and deliver high-quality vision to patients after cataract surgery. Additional information about RxSight can be found at www.rxsight.com.

data.title: STEPHEN A. SMITH ADDRESSES WHITE HOUSE DINNER ATTENDANCE, REAFFIRMS COMMITMENT TO HBCUs AND PROTECTING CORPORATE INVESTMENT IN BLACK EDUCATION
data.description:
STEPHEN A. SMITH ADDRESSES WHITE HOUSE DINNER ATTENDANCE, REAFFIRMS COMMITMENT TO HBCUs AND PROTECTING CORPORATE INVESTMENT IN BLACK EDUCATION

STEPHEN A. SMITH ADDRESSES WHITE HOUSE DINNER ATTENDANCE, REAFFIRMS COMMITMENT TO HBCUs AND PROTECTING CORPORATE INVESTMENT IN BLACK EDUCATION

PR Newswire

NEW YORK, Oct. 23, 2026

NEW YORK, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Stephen A. Smith, media mogul, New York Times bestselling author, and proud 1991 graduate of Winston-Salem State University, is addressing the public discussion surrounding his decision to attend a White House dinner with President Donald Trump, emphasizing his commitment to the long-term financial stability of Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs).

For Smith, the decision was rooted in a commitment to institutions that have educated generations of Black leaders, professionals, entrepreneurs, and public servants.

"I will always advocate for HBCUs and the students whose futures depend on them," Smith said. "My reason for attending the White House dinner was to discuss the challenges these institutions face in securing long-term funding and to make the case that corporate America must continue to invest in them."

Smith acknowledged federal support through the FUTURE Act while expressing concern that political tensions surrounding diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) could discourage private companies from supporting HBCUs. He maintains that these institutions deserve sustained corporate partnerships, philanthropic contributions, and public investment.

"If we truly believe in free-market capitalism, businesses should be able to support educational institutions and charitable causes without fear of criticism or repercussions," Smith said. "HBCUs have made extraordinary contributions to this country. They deserve sustained public and private investment."

Ashley Christopher, Esq., Founder and CEO of the HBCU Week Foundation, recognized Smith's advocacy and decision to engage with the administration.

"Stephen A. Smith has been a powerful advocate for HBCUs, using his platform and influence to shine a national spotlight on our institutions," expressed Christopher, "His continued support of HBCU Week helps advance our mission of connecting students with life-changing educational opportunities, and we are proud to have him as our ambassador."

Since Smith became an HBCU Week Ambassador in 2019, the initiative has facilitated more than 15,000 on-the-spot college acceptances and raised and awarded more than $150 million in scholarships, according to the HBCU Week Foundation.

As public discussion continues, Smith is emphasizing the importance of ensuring HBCUs have the resources and partnerships needed to educate future generations and expand opportunities for students.

data.title: Pathalys Pharma Presents Positive Data from Pivotal Phase 3 Studies of Upacicalcet in Featured Oral Presentation at ASN Kidney Week 2026
data.description:
Pathalys Pharma Presents Positive Data from Pivotal Phase 3 Studies of Upacicalcet in Featured Oral Presentation at ASN Kidney Week 2026

Pathalys Pharma Presents Positive Data from Pivotal Phase 3 Studies of Upacicalcet in Featured Oral Presentation at ASN Kidney Week 2026

PR Newswire

RALEIGH, N.C., Oct. 23, 2026

~ In PATH-1 and PATH-2 upacicalcet met primary and key secondary endpoints of reducing parathyroid hormone (PTH) in patients with end-stage kidney disease and Secondary Hyperparathyroidism (SHPT) on hemodialysis

~ Upacicalcet also reduced FGF23 and markers of bone turnover in the trial population ~

~ The pivotal data were simultaneously published in the Journal of the American Society of Nephrology ~

RALEIGH, N.C., Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pathalys Pharma, Inc., a private, US-based biopharmaceutical company committed to supporting the unique needs of patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), today presented data demonstrating the company's investigational calcimimetic, upacicalcet, met the primary endpoint and prespecified secondary endpoints in two pivotal Phase 3 studies, PATH-1 and PATH-2, that evaluated the safety and efficacy of upacicalcet in patients with secondary hyperparathyroidism (SHPT) and end-stage kidney disease receiving hemodialysis (HD).1,2

Upacicalcet is an investigational product candidate and has not been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

Results were presented during scientific sessions at the American Society of Nephrology (ASN) Kidney Week 2026 in Denver, CO and simultaneously published in the Journal of the American Society of Nephrology (JASN).

In its featured oral presentation, "Efficacy and Safety of Upacicalcet in Hemodialysis Patients with Secondary Hyperparathyroidism (SHPT): Two Randomized Clinical Trials (RCTs)", the company reported upacicalcet met the primary endpoint of the proportion of participants achieving ≥30% reductions of intact parathyroid hormone (iPTH) compared with placebo during the efficacy assessment period (EAP). Consistent with the 2017 KDIGO guideline update the PATH trials estimated the effect of upacicalcet under a controlled background-treatment protocol that limited changes in supplemental calcium and active vitamin D sterols.3,4

Upacicalcet also met the prespecified secondary endpoints of the proportion of participants achieving ≥50% reductions iPTH and the proportion of participants achieving iPTH of 150-300 pg/mL, which is the target range established by the National Kidney Foundation's Kidney Disease Outcomes Quality Initiative (K/DOQI).5

"Clinicians caring for patients with CKD undergoing dialysis face a multitude of complex challenges, including the management of SHPT. Persistent elevations in parathyroid hormone may contribute to serious complications, including fractures, vascular calcification, and cardiovascular disease, which may place patients at increased risk of hospitalization and death," said Jessica Kendrick, MD, MPH, Professor, Division of Renal Diseases and Hypertension, Department of Medicine at the University of Colorado Anschutz and Primary Investigator of the studies. "As clinicians work to address the many interconnected challenges that patients face, there remains a need for new treatment options and approaches that can help advance the management of SHPT."

In both studies, upacicalcet was generally well tolerated. The rates of serious adverse events (SAEs) were similar for upacicalcet and placebo. The rates of gastrointestinal adverse events (AEs) – the most common of which were diarrhea and nausea – were similar for upacicalcet and placebo. The most frequent AE was asymptomatic hypocalcemia (23% for upacicalcet vs. 8% for placebo in PATH-1; 19% vs. 11%, respectively, in PATH-2). Symptomatic hypocalcemia with upacicalcet was observed in 0.8% (2/239) of participants in PATH-1 and 2% (6/271) of participants in PATH-2, vs. 0.0% for placebo in both studies.3

"Nearly half a million people in the United States receive hemodialysis, and with SHPT affecting nearly all patients with kidney failure receiving maintenance dialysis, the need for new and approved treatment approaches is both significant and urgent," said Bastian Dehmel, MD, Chief Medical Officer of Pathalys Pharma. "At Pathalys, we believe every person living with CKD deserves access to innovation that addresses the key challenges they face. Our commitment to advancing new treatment options for SHPT reflects our broader mission to help address the unmet needs in CKD.

Separately at Kidney Week 2026, Pathalys presented additional data from PATH-1 and PATH-2 in the poster, "CKD-MBD Biomarker Profile in HD Patients With SHPT Treated With Upacicalcet: Biomarker Results From the Phase 3 PATH-1 and PATH-2 Trials." The results suggested upacicalcet produced improvements across the full CKD-MBD (chronic kidney disease–mineral and bone disorder) profile, including reductions in iPTH and whole PTH (wPTH); reductions in C-terminal and intact FGF23, a risk marker for cardiovascular events and mortality in this patient population; and three markers of bone turnover.6

Upacicalcet is an investigational small molecule calcimimetic that acts as a positive allosteric modulator.7 It is thought to activate CaSR in the presence of extracellular calcium, with little agonist activity when calcium falls below the physiologic range.8

About PATH-1 and PATH-2
PATH-1 (NCT05832931) and PATH-2 (NCT05836220) were identical, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials comparing the safety and efficacy of intravenous (IV) upacicalcet (PLS240) with placebo in patients with secondary hyperparathyroidism (SHPT) and end-stage renal disease receiving hemodialysis. Consistent with the 2017 KDIGO guideline update, the PATH trials estimated the effect of upacicalcet under a controlled background-treatment protocol that limited changes in supplemental calcium and active vitamin D sterols.

PATH-1 and PATH-2 randomized 359 and 409 participants, respectively, in a 2:1 ratio to receive either upacicalcet or placebo following each hemodialysis session for 27 weeks. For participants randomized to receive upacicalcet, dose titration occurred over the first 19 weeks: participants received an initial upacicalcet dose of either 25 or 50 mcg, depending on cCa (corrected serum calcium) levels, then were eligible for dose increases every three weeks through Week 19 to 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 and 300 mcg, in stepwise fashion, if cCa≥8.3 mg/dL and PTH>300 pg/mL. Participants then remained on a stable dose of upacicalcet for Weeks 20-27, with Weeks 22-27 constituting the efficacy assessment period (EAP).

After completing the double-blind phase of the studies, all participants had the opportunity to enroll in the open-label extension to receive upacicalcet three times per week for a maximum of 26 weeks.

About Pathalys
Pathalys is a private, U.S.-based biopharmaceutical company committed to supporting the unique needs of patients living with chronic kidney disease (CKD). An initial area of focus is pursuing advancements in the treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism (SHPT), a common complication for the approximately 486,000 patients in the U.S. with CKD undergoing hemodialysis.

Pathalys is developing upacicalcet, a calcimimetic for the treatment of SHPT. SHPT develops as the body struggles to maintain healthy calcium, phosphorus and parathyroid hormone levels when kidney function is lost.

Founded in 2021, Pathalys was built to be a biopharmaceutical company focused on innovation to meet the needs of patients living with CKD.

data.description:
THE PATRIOT FUND HONORS VETERANS AND MARKS AMERICA'S 250TH AT 11TH ANNUAL GALA AT THE UNION LEAGUE OF PHILADELPHIA

THE PATRIOT FUND HONORS VETERANS AND MARKS AMERICA'S 250TH AT 11TH ANNUAL GALA AT THE UNION LEAGUE OF PHILADELPHIA

PR Newswire

PHILADELPHIA, Oct. 23, 2026

Army and Navy Veterans headline the evening as Union League past president Frank Giordano is named 2026 Greater Philadelphia Area Patriot of the Year

PHILADELPHIA, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Patriot Fund will bring together Veterans, military families, supporters and community leaders on Friday, October 23, 2026, for the 11th Annual Patriot Fund Gala at the Union League of Philadelphia. Held in the city where our nation was founded, in the year America celebrates its 250th anniversary, this year's gala honors the men and women who have served and the families who stand behind them.

For 11 years, The Patriot Fund has helped Veterans and their families overcome the challenges they face when returning home from service. Support raised through the gala helps the organization fund its vetted, "Best in Class" partner organizations, which deliver essential services and ongoing support to Veterans and their families.

Fittingly, the evening's program will be led by those who have worn the uniform. The Patriot Fund is proud to welcome back Major Jonathan Turnbull, U.S. Army (Ret.), as Keynote Speaker, along with Evangelo "Vann" Morris, U.S. Navy (Ret.), Surface Warfare Officer, as Special Presenter. Guests will also enjoy a cocktail hour, dinner and live music from the band Don't Call Me Francis.

The Patriot Fund will also recognize Frank Giordano, President and CEO of Atlantic Trailer Leasing Corporation, as the 2026 Greater Philadelphia Area Patriot of the Year. Giordano is a longtime member and past president of the Union League of Philadelphia.

"Frank's commitment to preserving and advancing the American story is one of his most admirable traits," said Ryan Peters, who nominated Giordano for the award. "For decades, he has exemplified the highest ideals of American citizenship through his unwavering commitment to community service and his steadfast devotion to the principles on which our nation was founded."

"As the year draws to a close and Veterans Day approaches, we are more grateful than ever for the support our communities have shown us, and in turn, our Veterans," said Matthew Ellison, Executive Director of The Patriot Fund. "Gathering in the city where our country was founded feels especially fitting as we celebrate its 250th anniversary. Every guest and sponsor in that room is helping make sure the Veterans who served this nation, and the families who served alongside them, have the support they need when they come home."

Sponsorship opportunities and event details are available at PF2026.givesmart.com.

ABOUT THE PATRIOT FUND

The Patriot Fund is dedicated to providing the critical funding Veterans need to ensure they and their families have access to essential services and ongoing support throughout their lives. We carefully vet and support only "Best in Class" partners: organizations making a meaningful and measurable difference in the lives of Veterans today. Through our Stories of Impact, we shine a light on the challenges facing our Veteran community and the organizations working to address them.
